cd /app/tmp/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,sys
sys.set_int_max_str_digits(8192)
for name in ("manyflows","maxrules"):
    with open("perf/%s.out"%name) as fh:
        last=None
        n=0
        for line in fh:
            last=line; n+=1
    v=json.loads(last)
    if "checkpoint" in v:
        ck=v["checkpoint"]
        s=json.dumps(ck,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True).encode('ascii')
        F=len(ck["f"])
        print(name,"lines",n,"flows",F,"ckpt bytes",len(s),"limit",512+8192*F,"per-flow",len(s)/max(1,F))
        # depth
        def d(x,k=1):
            if isinstance(x,dict): return max([d(y,k+1) for y in x.values()] or [k])
            if isinstance(x,list): return max([d(y,k+1) for y in x] or [k])
            return k
        print("  depth",d(ck))
    else:
        print(name,"last line not checkpoint", last[:100])
EOF
